name: no-common-slot
about: Nora and Omar want each other's things (a jacket for a chair) and both say yes to the trade, but Nora is free only 10-11 and Omar only 11-12. With no common 30-minute slot in the window, the trade unwinds with that reason and both stay listed.

people.name: Nora Ellis
people.says: Have a jacket, size S. Need a chair.
people.reasons: My chair broke and I'm studying on the floor.

people.name: Omar Saleh
people.says: Got a chair, need a jacket size S.
people.reasons: It's a gift for my sister.
